title: Financial Services Credit, KYB/AML & Claims Underwriting Configuration

org_configured.description: True once Financial Services Credit, KYB/AML & Claims Underwriting organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

min_dscr.description: Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio covenant floor.

max_net_leverage.description: Maximum Net Debt / EBITDA covenant ceiling.

stress_rate_shock_bps.description: Severe floating-rate interest rate shock in basis points.

ubo_standard_pct.description: Standard cumulative beneficial ownership disclosure threshold %.

ubo_edd_pct.description: Reduced UBO threshold % when high-risk jurisdiction or PEP triggers EDD.

velocity_spike_multiplier.description: 30d-to-90d transaction velocity ratio triggering AML alert.

structuring_count_threshold.description: Near-$10k deposit count threshold for structuring flag.

high_value_claim_threshold.description: Net claim reserve escalation authority ceiling in USD.
